content.comment_body: Let me clarify: I have some potentiometers connected to a small 24V to 12V DC step-down converter, supplying 12V to the potentiometer. I chose not to add another resistor to reduce it to 10V, since the [product_name] I am using accepts 12/24V as input, and the readings display correctly in the [product_name] configuration software. Additionally, I am using a KTP400 [product_name] panel, and I’m trying to figure out how to display the analog values on the HMI—such as with a level indicator—though I’m not sure how to move the data from [product_name] configuration software to the TIA Portal HMI. I’m familiar with showing digital values but not analog. The potentiometer’s analog values do show up in the [product_name] configuration program. Any advice? Is this the correct place to ask?

If your transformer outputs 24VAC to 12VAC, it is providing AC voltage. Please note the analog input for the 12/24 [product_name] variant uses 0–10 VDC, not VAC. Which TIA Portal [version_no] are you working with? Kindly upload your [product_name] program as a ZIP file and specify the blocks you want shown on the HMI analog display. With this information, I can prepare a suitable example for you.

Apologies, I meant DC to DC step-down: from 24VDC to 12VDC. Here’s the link to the product: [url]. I also have a 12VDC to 5VDC variant. I recently built a small trainer kit for the [product_name], with plans to later upgrade to the [version_no]. Everything functions in [product_name] configuration software—I see the values changing. I don’t have a dedicated program for the HMI display; right now, I just want to test viewing the analog potentiometer values from [product_name] configuration software on the TIA Portal HMI, even with a basic analog input. Ideally, I’d like to show the potentiometer output via a level indicator or a simple I/O label in the HMI. My TIA Portal [version_no] is 16.0, but the HMI runs on 15.1, since I still need to update the HMI’s image. Although I haven’t completed that update, digital outputs show perfectly on the HMI, but the analog display remains problematic.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users are working to visualize analog input readings from a potentiometer—connected using a DC step-down converter to a [product_name] controller—on an HMI panel via TIA Portal and [product_name] configuration software. Analog value acquisition within the configuration software is successful, but users encounter difficulties transferring and displaying these readings on the HMI. Issues arise due to uncertain analog signal mapping and discrepancies between project software versions, resulting in user confusion on achieving a working visualization.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an easy and understandable procedure for showing analog values from the [product_name] controller on the KTP400 [product_name] HMI panel, similar to what’s available for digital signal display.
